sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
loginNote: Projects, runs and keys are isolated by workspace.
productNote: Billed to your own model account
confirmArchive: Archive this project and preserve its run history?
name: Project name
firstTask: Add a target and generate a plan
noExecution: Select a task to see its workflow
modelNotice: AutoQA provides no model credits. Requests are billed to your own Provider account.
sessionNotice: Session configuration is encrypted in server memory and lost after logout, expiry or server restart.
encryptedNotice: Workspace keys are encrypted on the server. Only a mask is returned to the browser.
connectionOk: Connected. Testing a connection makes a small request to your Provider.
confirmDeleteModel: Delete this model? The most recently added standby model becomes the default.
connectionCostNote: Testing sends a minimal request and may incur a small model charge.
onboardingModelCenter: Save a model configuration to continue setup.
ownerOnly: Only workspace owners can change model configuration
goalPlaceholder: For example: sign in, create an order and check that it appears in the order list
runSecretNote: Use {{USERNAME}}, {{PASSWORD}} or {{TOKEN}} to reference secrets. Run-only accounts are never persisted.
noEndpoints: Import a specification or add endpoints first
secretKeep: Blank secrets and account fields preserve saved values. Delete the environment configuration to remove all saved credentials.
reviewNote: Review every request, input, assertion and mutation. Execution starts only after human approval.
planEditor: Plan editor (JSON: edit or add steps and cases)
reportNote: Assertion failures and system errors are counted separately. Review suggestions against the evidence.
evidencePrivacy: Screenshots are omitted when run variables are configured. Production does not save credential-bearing Playwright traces.
connectionFailed: Could not load workspace; please retry
title: Task title
planChanged: Save your plan changes before approving
onboardingWelcomeNote: Your account and workspace are ready. Next, create your first test project.
onboardingModelNote: AutoQA uses your own model service.
onboardingModelOptional: You can create a project first and configure your model service later.
onboardingModelReserved: The model setup entry is reserved. Finish creating your project, then open Model service from the Dashboard.
onboardingProjectNote: Name your project and choose a test type. Add a test target later.
onboardingReadyNote: Your first test project has been saved.
onboardingNextNote: Continue from the Dashboard to configure your model, add a test target, and complete your first test.
onboardingProgressNote: Follow these steps to complete your first use.
apiSpecHint: JSON / YAML · OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 · Maximum 1 MB. Configure Base URL later.
apiNoDocuments: No API documents yet. Upload a document to view its endpoints.
apiPlanningPending: Test planning will be available in a later phase.
apiSpecTooLarge: Choose an API document no larger than 1 MB
apiSpecFormat: Only JSON / YAML files are supported
confirmDeleteApiSpec: Delete this API document and its parsed endpoints?
plannerDetailHint: Review plan status, scenario coverage, test steps and expected results.
plannerMissingModel: Configure and activate a model in Model Center before generating a plan.
plannerHint: AI covers positive, negative, boundary and security scenarios. Up to 20 endpoints per document; review requests before execution.
plannerFailed: Generation failed. No cases were saved. Details are in the action error or the plan's safe logs.
plannerBudget: Current document: {count} endpoints, at most {batch} per batch; at most {calls} model requests. No automatic model retry.
plannerZeroSaved: No test cases were saved (Persisted Case Count = 0).
plannerError_json_parse: The model output could not be parsed as a JSON object.
plannerError_schema_validation: The structured output did not satisfy the required format.
plannerError_unknown_endpoint: The model referenced an endpoint outside this batch.
plannerError_duplicate_case: Case names must be unique within each endpoint.
plannerError_missing_category_coverage: An endpoint is missing required scenario categories.
plannerError_endpoint_case_limit: An endpoint exceeded the limit of 12 cases across all categories combined.
plannerError_context_too_large: A batch context exceeded the size limit. No model request was made.
plannerError_provider_timeout: The model service request timed out.
plannerError_provider_failure: The model service request failed. Check configuration or availability.
plannerError_persistence_failure: Saving the plan failed. The case transaction was rolled back.
plannerError_planner_timeout: The entire plan generation timed out.
plannerEmpty: Upload an API specification and configure a model to generate your first plan.
executionMissingTarget: Edit the project and set a public Base URL
executionHint: AI generates candidate test intent. Each case sends one HTTP request; prose steps are not executed. Review the request, expected status and JSON assertions below. Execution uses the configuration frozen at approval.
executionScenarioReview: OpenAPI execution sample; not confirmed to satisfy this scenario or all constraints. Review the request, expected status and assertions.
executionDefaults: OpenAPI execution sample; not confirmed to satisfy this scenario or all constraints.
executionInterrupted: Completed results were saved; unfinished cases are not counted as passed. Rerunning may repeat business writes.
executionAssertions: JSON assertions (exists / equals / type; dotted paths, arrays: users.0.id)
executionRerunHint: Rerun creates a new run using approved configuration and may repeat business writes.
executionLegacy: Historical classification is inferred from limited evidence; original records are unchanged.
executionLegacyEvidence: This historical run has no saved assertion evidence.
executionEvidenceTruncated: Redacted display evidence was truncated; assertions used the complete original response.
qualityRateNote: Pass rate = passed / all planned cases; errors and pending cases remain in the denominator.
qualityIncomplete: Partial report: the run is incomplete; review pending cases.
qualityCost: This operation uses your configured model service and incurs its model fees.
qualityCache: Successful analysis is reused by default; reanalysis incurs new fees.
qualityNoProvider: No model configured; the report, evidence and exports remain available.
qualityEvidenceLoad: Expand to read saved, redacted evidence.
candidateReference: Candidate prose is reference only and does not establish executed steps or coverage. Approved configuration and Evidence describe actual execution.
